name: score-docked-lines
_note: SF-M (SCORE_FINISH_SPEC.md §4.2, the DL arm; Sept 29, 2026): the lines the reviews DOCKED, typed on the boot board, one arm the instrument reads for command C4, diplomacy C4/C5, first contact C3/C4, economy C5 and combat legibility C4. Every line names the row it answers to in `dl_lines`; `tools/score_run.py check` reads each command's reply against that row's pass condition. The arm GROWS: a new review's docked line is appended with its row id, never re-authored. Run with --turns 3. Order matters, so no line spoils another's measurement: turn 1 spends its four actions on the 2-AP strategic order (RS-8) and Davout's fortify at Rhineland, so the what-if (RS-12) asks about a FORTIFIED man with Mack adjacent at Swabia; turn 2 carries the support phrasings (RS-6) and the eight Cabinet phrasings (RS-7); turn 3 asks for terms once the war is old enough (PC15-6), tries the two proper names (SF-V4), burns the military actions on three scouts, then asks 'what can I do' (RS-15) at zero military actions and raises the levy with Davout, who has not moved (AAR-6).
